info.title: postgresql-sharp-mcp — database-agnostic PostgreSQL MCP over stdio
info.description: Database-agnostic PostgreSQL MCP server with live discovery and bounded per-call database selection using Npgsql.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Recommended: inherit POSTGRES_CONNECTION_STRING from a prepared shell or secret manager.
No targets JSON file is required for a single PostgreSQL server.

options.name: --targets-file
options.description: JSON object: connection profile -> Npgsql seed connection

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: Optional CLI value; prefer environment input to avoid exposed secret arguments

options.name: --databases
options.description: Optional explicit database allowlist (JSON string array)

options.name: --validate
options.description: Check each configured seed connection and exit; diagnostics on stderr
